title: Local Manager shared auth-host rate-limit recovery

phases.objective: Prevent background desktop polling from exhausting the shared auth-host request budget while preserving fail-closed privileged-action version verification.

e2e_journeys.actor: Linked Mad4B Local Manager Windows app
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A linked desktop polls for commands while the user requests pairing, update status, or connector repair.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Background polling runs at a bounded 30-second cadence, honors the server Retry-After value on HTTP 429, and leaves shared request capacity for interactive actions. Pairing and update failures expose only bounded secret-safe retry evidence, while repair remains blocked until current-version verification succeeds.
steps: Start background desktop-command polling at a 30-second interval.
Classify HTTP 429 without copying response bodies or credentials into diagnostics.
Honor a bounded Retry-After delta/date before the next background poll.
Show a retry window for rate-limited pairing and update checks.
Keep privileged connector repair fail-closed when release verification cannot complete.
Publish the changed executable and public fallback URLs as version 0.2.29.
assertions: An idle linked desktop generates at most two scheduled command polls per minute before backoff.
Server Retry-After is bounded to 1 through 300 seconds and is never shortened by local backoff.
Pairing, update, and repair diagnostics contain no token, command payload, or secret.
A 429 never authorizes connector repair or bypasses current-version verification.
The project and release-owner route agree on version 0.2.29.
No Production deployment, database mutation, provider mutation, secret rotation, or credential creation is performed.
